cause: The updater treated freshclam exit zero as a successful check, despite actual 1.5.4 returning zero with a 429/cooldown diagnostic. Unchanged old CVDs then triggered completed/unchanged, cleared pending and removed the work stage.

change.updater_output: Inspect both bounded stdout and stderr for known FreshClam received-429 and You-are-(still)-on-cool-down notices; updater invocation only.
change.ordering: Always finish and verify provider state synchronization in finally before reporting rate_limited. A synchronization failure follows the existing error/failed path and leaves the new stage and pending synchronization journal.

change.wait_semantics: The stored 24h guard stays a minimum. Neither binary provider state nor a human local-time log date is decoded. Static warning requires owner confirmation of all provider waits, which may exceed that minimum; the pending state prevents even a post-24h automatic download until owner recovery. Owner CLI may persist a longer explicit deadline.
change.privacy: Only static warnings/structured state are returned. Raw logs, credentials, private paths and provider binary bytes are not echoed.
change.normal_behavior: A genuine normal unchanged check still completes and cleans its successful work stage; routine DNS/404 fallback warnings and a version number 429 are not classified as waiting.
